# fixture-cli

A tiny command line tool that counts words.

![demo](docs/demo.gif)

![badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/ok-yes-green.svg)

## Quick start

```bash
npm install -g fixture-cli
fixture count notes.txt
```

Output:

```
notes.txt: 128 words
```

Website: [fixture.example](https://fixture.example/)

~~~sh
fixture --help
~~~
